info.title: AccessPay Merchant API
info.description:
Voice-first accessible commerce APIs for conversational product discovery, shopping-session management, cart operations, safer checkout, order history, and PayPal-powered payment workflows.

**Prototype Notice:** Prototype API. Production merchant authentication and tenant isolation are not yet implemented.

**Safety Boundary:** AI (Google Gemini) interprets natural-language intent and conversational follow-ups, while product prices, cart totals, confirmation gates, and PayPal Sandbox execution remain strictly server-authoritative.

get.description: Return all products currently available in the local product catalog cache.
Return the active product search provider mode (channel3, mock, or auto).

post.description: Switch the active product search provider between channel3, mock, and auto.

get.description: Returns the single authoritative active search session snapshot synchronized with frontend cards.
Lightweight, non-Channel3 query suggestions derived from history, saved items, and catalog cache.
Retrieve full details for a single product by its product ID.

post.summary: Search for products using the configured commerce provider
post.description: Searches physical products using the configured commerce provider (Channel3 in this hackathon prototype; future deployments may plug in merchant-owned catalogs). Synchronizes the active shopping session.
Appends the next batch of candidates for the current ActiveSearchSession.
Compare two or more selected products across price, rating, merchant, and key attributes.

get.description: Returns all cart items with server-computed subtotal, shipping, tax, and total.

delete.summary: Clear all items from the cart
delete.description: Remove all items from the active shopping cart.

post.summary: Add an item to the cart
post.description: Adds a verified product to the cart and recalculates server-authoritative totals.

put.description: Update the quantity of an item currently in the active shopping cart.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the cart
delete.description: Remove a matching item from the active shopping cart by product ID or title.

post.description: Record explicit user acknowledgement of recurring subscription or trial terms on the active purchase review.

get.description: Return the current confirmation state machine status and active purchase review, if any.

post.description: Computes server-authoritative item subtotal, shipping, tax, and total, and issues a review_token required before confirmation.

Enforces deterministic confirmation binding the exact server-computed total before PayPal order creation. Ambiguous consent ('yes', 'okay', 'go ahead') is rejected. AI may never silently authorize payment.
Cancel the active purchase review and reset the confirmation gate without charging the user.

post.summary: Simulate a price change during checkout
post.description: Simulate a price change on the active review, invalidating any prior confirmation token.

get.description:
Returns public-only PayPal Sandbox configuration for the frontend SDK.
NEVER exposes PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET.

post.summary: Create PayPal Sandbox order after explicit confirmation
post.description: Creates a one-time PayPal Sandbox order (Orders API v2) using server-authoritative totals. Requires prior explicit exact-amount confirmation and PayPal buyer approval before capture.

get.description:
Safely inspects live PayPal Sandbox order status (CREATED, APPROVED, COMPLETED)
so the UI only attempts capture after PayPal buyer approval.

post.description: Captures an approved PayPal Sandbox order and records the completed order with its PayPal capture ID.
Create a payment order through the active sandbox payment service.
Capture an approved payment order through the active sandbox payment service.
Enable or disable simulated payment gateway decline for testing failure handling.
Switch the active payment provider mode within the sandbox environment.

get.description: Return configuration and sandbox readiness status for the PayPal Orders API v2 gateway.
Retrieve all completed one-time orders from the local store.
Look up tracking and fulfillment status for a recent order by optional query.

post.summary: Check return eligibility for an order
post.description: Evaluate return eligibility and instructions for a previously purchased item.

post.summary: Prepare purchase review for the most recent order
post.description: Load the most recent completed order into the cart and prepare a fresh purchase review.

get.description: Fetch full details for a single completed order by its order ID.

post.summary: Prepare purchase review to reorder a specific order
post.description: Load items from a specific past order into the cart and prepare a fresh purchase review.

get.description: Retrieve all products saved by the user for later review or purchase.

post.description: Save a product from the catalog or active search session to the user's Saved Items list.

delete.description: Remove a product from the user's Saved Items list by saved item ID.

post.description: Add a previously saved product directly into the active shopping cart.

get.description: Retrieve all saved product search queries and their associated filters.

post.description: Save the active search session or a specified query and filters as a reusable Saved Search.

delete.description: Remove a saved search entry by its saved search ID.

post.description: Execute a saved search query with its stored filters and update the active search session.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent product search history entries.

delete.description: Delete all entries from the recent search history list.

post.description: Re-execute a previous search from recent search history and update the active search session.

post.summary: Promote recent search to saved search
post.description: Save an entry from recent search history as a persistent Saved Search.

get.description: Retrieve the current accessibility preferences for the active session.

put.description: Update one or more accessibility preference fields for the active session.

post.description: Switch the active accessibility mode preference.
Reset all accessibility preferences back to their default values.

Routes natural-language shopping, comparison, cart, saved-item, and checkout-navigation commands. May invoke Google Gemini for NLU and Channel3 for product discovery. Gemini never supplies authoritative prices, cart totals, or payment authorization.

get.description: Return suggested voice commands tailored to the active shopping context.
Return configuration and availability status for the conversational AI provider.

post.description: Clear the active conversational AI history and shopping intent context.

get.description: Retrieve all upcoming and recent commerce timeline events for the active session.

post.description: Filter or query commerce timeline events using natural language.

get.description: Retrieve summary metrics for voice and accessibility interactions.

post.description: Translate a natural-language query into structured purchase analytics results.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent security and confirmation audit log events.
Return the built-in AccessPay demonstration scenarios.

post.description:
RESET DEMO: Resets shopping session, cart, current product selection,
and confirmation state without altering secrets or environment configuration.
Deterministically sets up state for a specific demo scenario.

get.description: Return AccessPay Merchant API endpoints, integration guides, and non-secret provider readiness status.
Search the isolated Demo Subscription Catalog (never routed through Channel3).
List persisted user subscriptions (separate from one-time Orders).
Retrieve full billing terms and metadata for a specific demo subscription offer.

post.description: Answer user questions about renewal frequency, cancellation, and pricing for a subscription offer.
Prepares recurring subscription disclosure (due today, recurring amount, billing frequency, renewal & cancellation terms) without creating any subscription.

post.summary: Confirm recurring subscription amount and billing frequency
post.description: Deterministic confirmation gate requiring BOTH exact recurring amount and billing frequency. Distinct from one-time Orders confirmation.

post.summary: Create PayPal Sandbox subscription after recurring confirmation
post.description: Creates a PayPal Sandbox subscription via Subscriptions API v1 (/v1/billing/subscriptions). Blocked unless explicit recurring confirmation was granted.

get.description: Fetch the latest status of a PayPal Sandbox subscription by subscription ID.

post.description: Cancel an active PayPal Sandbox subscription after verifying the explicit cancellation confirmation phrase.

get.description:
Render Health Check endpoint (/health).
Returns {"status": "ok"} and safe component readiness without exposing any secrets.
Alias under /api/health for frontend health probes.
Return basic service metadata, version, and documentation entrypoints.

action.description: Resolved application action (e.g., SEARCH_RESULTS, COMPARE, PAYMENT_REVIEW_READY).

speech_response.description: Accessible spoken/display summary of the result.

message.description: Natural-language shopping or navigation command from voice or text.

active_search_id.description: Active search session identifier for contextual follow-ups.

search_generation.description: Monotonic search generation counter to discard stale turns.

visible_product_ids.description: IDs of products currently displayed to the user.

raw_transcript.description: Raw speech-to-text transcript prior to normalization.

current_view.description: Current UI view name (e.g., SHOP, CART, ORDERS).
